about.headline: A technical artist who fell in love with system architecture but never left the creative world behind.
about.summary: I am a creative polymath and Python engineer who treats software architecture like a complex puzzle. Coming from a deep background in scriptwriting, filmmaking, animation and 3D modeling, I bring a completely fresh perspective to backend engineering. I am not weighed down by legacy coding dogma. Instead I natively blend AI development tools with creative design thinking, allowing me to bridge the gap between technical plumbing and frictionless experience.
